Mystic Mountain, Jageshwar — a retreat brochure (2019).

A tri-fold brochure for a Himalayan retreat in Jageshwar, Uttarakhand: forest-green panels, misty mountain photography and a calm editorial grid carrying the property, its accommodation, and its programs — Explore, Experience, Rejuvenate. Folded, it's a pocket invitation to the hills.

Brochure design — Anirudh Kapoor. A·71.
